verdict.rationale: Every endpoint page on Mercury's ReadMe-hosted API Reference embeds a live "Try It!" request runner. Each page also has generated code samples in Shell, Node, Ruby, PHP and Python, a Bearer credentials field, per-endpoint params and response schemas. A pre-loaded sandbox lets examples run without real money, and llms.txt plus .md page variants make the reference agent-readable. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the Try It runner works in practice, and explicit documentation that the runner can target the sandbox base URL.
